rationale: Although the stock is experiencing strong downward momentum after failing its opening gap—trading well below VWAP ($174.44) and the prior close ($171.45) on 2.60x relative volume—it is currently extended over $5.00 below its 5-minute 9-EMA ($175.63) following five consecutive lower 1-minute candles. Entering short at the bottom of a nearly $9.00 morning flush offers poor risk-reward due to snapback risk, while catching a falling knife long against heavy selling pressure lacks any structural confirmation of a bottom. Additionally, the portfolio already has 44.9% of buying power committed to short orders, making an extended short chase here imprudent.
